caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a blue bonnet with ties, presented predominantly in the center of the image. The bonnet has a quilted texture on the inside brim, which is illustrated using diamond-shaped lines and shaded in a darker blue. A lace or ruffled trim, rendered in dark blue or black, runs along the edge of the brim. The main section of the bonnet is shaded with various tones of blue to show dimension, and long blue ribbons are attached at the sides, hanging down loosely. At the lower edge and near the ties, the fabric appears to be slightly transparent and delicately outlined. On the right side of the drawing, there are two smaller, simplified line sketches of the bonnet from different angles, one showing a frontal view with the ribbons untied and the other from the back with the ribbons tied into a bow. The background is a plain beige color.
title: Opera Hood
